summary: A catch-up recap post (no single day) covering several weeks: a car run-in (everyone ok), a team member leaving and a new one joining, three learning festival sessions, passing the St. Louis Arch and crossing the Missouri and Mississippi rivers, and a stop in Murphysboro, IL, under 1,000 miles from DC with a planned detour south to Nashville.
learning_festival: Taught three times during the period covered (dates, sites and activities not stated).
contacts: Kaitlyn and Turner's parents (town not stated; team ate Mexican food with them)
planning_notes: St. Louis Arch: the team went around it on grass rather than through the city, since their bikes do not like grass (per post).
Midwest stretch between St. Louis and southern Illinois: venomous snakes encountered several times (exact locations not stated).
A car hit a team member but everyone was ok; the post gives no details on how it happened or where.
Families hosted the team along the way; the post thanks edX for donated jerseys (sponsor mention).

summary: The team rode into Washington, DC at 11:24am on August 24, 2013, finishing the Pacific-to-Atlantic ride (post says more than 6,000 km), and planned celebrations, thank-you cards and a post-trip reflection series.
planning_notes: Food on the trip, per post: banana-honey-oatmeal, peanut butter sandwiches and pasta.
